data.description: Container nav element. Collapsible groups inside the nav are <details> with `data-aed-sn-group` ids. Open/closed state persists in localStorage; the group containing the active link is auto-opened (matches by URL prefix, longest wins).

data-aed-sidenav-key.description: Prefix for the localStorage keys used to persist open/closed state. Use distinct values when multiple sidenavs coexist.

data.description: Each collapsible group inside the sidenav.

data-aed-sn-group.description: Stable id used as the localStorage key suffix.
